107a-eye.png: The eye as an optical instrument (Gate 13.1): NEI’s path of light; Gullstrand’s reduced eye (n = 4/3, r = 5.7 mm, Helmholtz p. 355) gives the retinal image of a person 10 m away; Helmholtz’s diffraction circle δ = 2.440 lr/d against pupil diameter (p. 196); Listing’s printed radius 5.1248 mm beside f₂ − f₁ = 5.0674 mm.
107b-colour.png: Colour (Gate 13.1): peaks of the Stockman & Sharpe (2000) cone fundamentals (L 566, M 541, S 441 nm) and of the CIE day (555 nm) and night (506 nm) luminosity functions, located in CVRL’s tables; only the peaks are drawn.
107c-hearing.png: Hearing (Gate 13.2): NIDCD’s path of sound; Fletcher & Munson’s intensity level β = 10 log J + 100 (J in µW/cm², reference 10⁻¹⁶ W/cm²); NIDCD’s 70 and 85 dBA statements.
107d-ecg.png: Heart signals (Gate 13.3): Waller (1887) and Einthoven (1912); a heart vector at Einthoven’s α = 76° projected onto leads I, II and III of his equilateral triangle, with lead II − lead I = lead III.
